export_config.advantage: q_next minus maximum q_next; every optimal action has zero advantage
export_config.folds: metadata-only salted hash order; floor(groups/4) validation groups, at least one if groups >=2
export_config.normalization: divide by max(original decision H,1), including prefix value
export_config.policy_loss: negative log total probability assigned to optimal_next set
export_config.prefix_value_semantics: Total original-state complete-protocol Q, not residual value after prefix execution
export_config.sampling: uniform state within its fold, then uniform nonterminal prefix within state; action loss averaged within prefix
export_config.scope: Pure derived TRAIN targets, no exact solves or network training
export_config.terminal_decoding: END only, policy loss masked; STOP at empty prefix only

limits: No new information or structures; inherited V1 coverage. Fold assignment not balanced by outcomes.
verification: all prefix Q/advantage/set targets checked by direct saved-candidate scan
